items.title: Dave Liebman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Yeah. Albert Duffy on timpani, and Patato. [INTERVIEWEE] There was a whole bunch of cats. I don’t remember much about that.

ctx.x: I seem to remember that some of the tunes were from maybe another date. I don’t remember. Mr. Jones is not a – I don’t think we sat and did it. That’s a lot of percussionists there. Frank Ippolito was there.
Yeah. Albert Duffy on timpani, and Patato.
There was a whole bunch of cats. I don’t remember much about that. I think New Breed’s on that, studio version.
